composition_variation: Create an original premium 2D anime wallpaper of exactly one woman, visibly 28 years old, with silvery lilac hair in a long low ponytail with softly curled tips. She has mature, self-assured elegance and realistic adult proportions. Give her clear amethyst eyes, graceful cheekbones, a subtly asymmetrical smile, and a relaxed mature presence. Her opaque pale-mint short-sleeved midi dress has a modest round neckline and flowing natural folds. Seated upright on a narrow bench, she holds a violin vertically against her lap with both hands resting naturally around its neck and lower edge; leave the bow in its closed case beside the bench. Keep the instrument compact and recognizable. Low rooftop planters, a distant pale city silhouette, and a partly open studio door provide context. Rose-gold sunset and cool lavender shadows create a tender intermission. Frame at eye level for a very tall phone crop. Keep her face, body, and hands inside the central narrow column, in the middle and lower image; leave the upper 25% calm and mostly empty for the clock. Natural nonsexual posture, opaque summer clothing, graceful anatomy, small readable hands close to her body. Refined linework, layered cel shading, painterly light, no text, logos, other people, or copied characters.
